title: Secure bulk settlement lifecycle with live customer scope and monetary validation
description: Stage3 core settlement and exception closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Require live enabled current identity, existing bulk-settlement menu and existing SalespersonDataScope before list count, detail, document numbers or writes for all CRUD/submit/approve/cancel/delete routes. Recheck persisted and proposed customer scope and real enabled customer; reject unknown ownership for restricted users. Preserve legitimate unrestricted historical access without adding grants. Validate positive rounded TotalAmount and nonnegative FreightCost using actual EF precision; do not invent currency, conversion, total=freight formula or infer shipment/order sources from text.

Serialize same-settlement edits and state/delete transitions in one compatible transaction; re-read persisted status, customer and amounts under lock, reject stale status/concurrency without partial changes, and preserve audit on denial. Create atomically validates before number reservation. Keep supported historical lifecycle semantics and soft-delete only; no stock, funds or accounting posting. Real controller SQL own/foreign/revoked/disabled, invalid amount, denied-edit audit and independent-connection edit vs submit / approve vs cancel; meaningful unit tests and safe Release verification. Each simulated request uses separate DbContext.

implementation_evidence: FinanceBulkSettlementController in FinanceSettlementControllers.cs still lists all customers, assigns numbers before scope/amount validation, mutates pending rows without locks and inherits unprotected transitions. FinanceBulkSettlement in Finance2.cs has CustomerId and raw TotalAmount/FreightCost but no currency or shipment source. Existing bulk-settlement menu is present in SeedData; no prior task secures this controller.
